test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 26 May 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
A given bar chart shows the heights of seven hills. Study the graph and answer the questions that follows.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4799c1727b7c5c92d8a392d7adae8aa941ab442b92e9d25207e82ec8fac34927.png] 

Which hill is the third highest?
solution:
**Given:**

The heights of hills H₁ , H₂ , H₃ , H₄ , H₅ , H₆ and H₇ are

8500 , 7000 , 6000 , 5000 , 8000 , 9000 and 8300 feets respectively as shown in the bar graph.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/73938754f6d87e460b688ace57311a466e1d9eb2cdd0391c4f35e8928731bd19.png] 

**Calculations:**

The highest hill is H₆ with 9000 feets height.

The second highest hill is H₁ with 8500 feets height.

and the third highest hill is H₇ with 8300 feets height.

**therefore The third highest hill is H₇.**
